company.name: Couchbase
company.shortDescription: Couchbase is a NoSQL cloud platform providing scalable data solutions for applications.
company.description: Couchbase is a NoSQL cloud platform that provides a flexible data management solution for modern applications. It enables developers to efficiently store and retrieve data in JSON format, supporting high-performance operations. The platform offers features such as built-in caching, scalability, and analytics capabilities, allowing organizations to handle large volumes of data seamlessly. Couchbase also supports various deployment options, including on-premises and cloud environments, catering to diverse business needs. By focusing on ease of use and integration, Couchbase helps teams build applications that require rapid data access and real-time analytics.

aiResearchSummary.text: Couchbase is developing high density data storage based on log structured storage techniques and compaction of documents in a high density data storage system using hybrid key value engines and segmented log stores. It advances vector search in embedded databases, access control systems for access revocation in a database replicated on a target, and processing time series and spatiotemporal data in document databases. It also works on distributed transaction execution management, cost based query optimization for untyped fields, efficient indexing for querying arrays, and a development environment integrated with a machine learning based language model. These efforts span storage engines, indexing, transactions, security, analytics, and developer tooling.
